## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das lässt mich kalt** — [das lesst mish kalt] — *That leaves me cold (I don't care)*
2. **Ich bin in meinem Element** — [ish bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element*
3. **Da liegt der Hase im Pfeffer** — [da leekt dair HAH-zuh im PFEF-fer] — *That's where the problem lies (lit. that's where the rabbit is in the pepper)*
